# Generated and vendored files

Do not hand-edit these files. Regenerate them with the tool that owns them.

| Path | Generator | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `healthcare/public/frontend/assets/patient_portal-*.js`, `*.js.map`, `*.css` | Vite build of `patient_portal/` | Hashed bundles are committed. Rebuild with `yarn build`; never edit them directly. They are excluded from pre-commit. |
| `healthcare/public/frontend/manifest.json`, `healthcare/public/frontend/index.html` | Vite build | `www/patient-portal/index.py` reads `manifest.json` to find the entry asset |
| `healthcare/www/patient_portal.html` | frappe-ui vite plugin (`indexHtmlPath`) | Written by the portal build |
| `healthcare/locale/main.pot` | `.github/helper/update_pot_file.sh` (weekly workflow) | Source of translation strings. `*.po` files come from Crowdin. |
| `healthcare/locale/*.po` | Crowdin sync | Commits are titled `fix: <language> translations` |
| `yarn.lock` | yarn | Lockfile; update only through yarn |
| `patient_portal/auto-imports.d.ts`, `patient_portal/components.d.ts` | unplugin auto-import/components (through frappe-ui vite) | Generated type shims |
| `healthcare/public/node_modules` | Symlink to a local bench path | An accidental machine-specific symlink. Do not depend on it or modify it. |
| `healthcare/healthcare/doctype/*/*.json` | Frappe DocType editor (Desk) | Schema JSON. Hand edits are allowed but must stay valid, and `modified` should be bumped so `bench migrate` re-syncs. |
| `healthcare/__init__.py` `__version__` | semantic-release (`.releaserc`) | Bumped automatically on release branches |

Ignored by git: `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.egg-info`, `healthcare/docs/current`.

Note: `patient_portal/vite.config.js` points `build.outDir` at `healthcare/public/patient_portal/assets`, but the committed and served assets live under `healthcare/public/frontend/`. Check this path before you rebuild.
